engine_notes.title: v3-time: definition change, not physics
items: The v3-air → v3-time delta below is a definition change, not a change in the physics of the airport. In v3-air the BTS scheduled arrival was treated as the wheels-on time. In v3-time it is a gate (in-block) time, and the earliest possible landing is the wheels-on time (scheduled arrival + arrival delay - taxi-in). Delay, pax and fuel are therefore measured against a different reference, on the same 50 waves and seed 7.

Status quo (baseline) moved by the definition alone, with nothing renegotiated: delay 343.2 → 335.5 min, pax protected 26.5 → 34.1 %, fuel 0.72 → 1.36 kg, overtime 1.76 → 1.86 min, feasible waves 34 → 33. That is the physics_delta in the Attribution section; read it as the definition effect.
